description: Routes explicitly marked messages between the registered Muse (Remmy) and ChatGPT (Alex) tabs. v0.6.2 — CRUSHER V6.2, built on the V6.1 live test's evidence (Ben's tap, 2026-11-07): identity is the envelope message_id (dedup, ledgers and delivery tracking key on it; the carried text wears a PB-ID line as a confirmation aid). A queue pump serves letters oldest-actionable-first across both directions; proven-absence retries (at most 2, 30s apart, same PB-ID — policy unchanged from Alex's ruling) wait in RETRY_WAIT without holding the bridge, and letters stalled by a generating or unreachable destination re-queue themselves, bounded, instead of parking for a sweep. Confirmation is seeable AND quiet-gated: recent user turns are scanned for the carried header + PB-ID, but a poll only counts while the destination page is not generating — a streaming page cannot testify a landed letter absent (the live test's duplicate-resend bug, seen on both platforms in one night). A page that never sits still yields UNKNOWN, never absence. Delivery defers while the destination generates (Ben's button gate reads the morphing button's own face, never clicks a stop face), waits briefly for a late-rendering send button on idle tabs, and types through the page's real input path first. Every attempt path leaves a trail entry — no letter sits unexplained. No LLM in the transport path. v0.16.0 — BRIDGE ALERT, popup only (Ben’s design, Alex approved as proposed): Remmy raises a local alert event; the extension shows a red emergency popup on the affected seat’s tab (fallback: any open bridge surface, named on the popup’s face), exactly one chime per alert ID, persistent until Ben closes it. Not a letter: no marker protocol, no reply; the letter machinery is untouched. v0.17.0 — THE SEND-SAFETY FENCE (Ben's design, his ruling): sending is no longer the button's word alone — at the moment of an attempt the bridge asks whether THIS message is safe to send, on three conditions (button status read from the composer's own button; serial order — every message carries a number that advances by counting, and a letter never jumps the count or sends after being superseded; message status — delivered is a state, and a delivered message is never sent again). Two positives and no proven negative send; a proven negative vetoes; UNKNOWN never counts as a pass. Held letters name the condition that held them; completed pairs retire into a small completed record when the next pair arrives. The alert chime is now Ben's Amaj7 synth chord. v0.18.0: the adapters' send-decision logic (button classification, composer scope, button state, generating verdict, send-button lookup, idle defer) lives in ONE shared module, sendcore.js — pass 1 narrowed the button read to the composer on the four remaining surfaces, pass 2 lifted the logic so a fix lands once. v0.19.0 — STAGE 1 (Build Plan 01): the strong PB-ID identity layer, the permanent registration ledger, capture acknowledgement, the bridge epoch and the legacy migration inventory run in the background (stage1core.js + stage1-wiring.js). Registration stays fail-closed: no adapter yet supplies a qualified native message identity, so live detections are acknowledged with their honest outcome, the legacy state is inventoried untouched, pause/disconnect advance the persisted epoch first — and no outbound behaviour changes. v0.19.1 — TERMINAL READOUT (Ben's tap, 2026-11-11): the panel's live-state block now ends with two plain terminal lines — the newest message's exact first line as the letterbox sees it, and the marker verdict (FOUND / in the text but not a clean line / NOT FOUND). Read-only: detection and delivery behaviour are unchanged. v0.21.0 — COMBINED BUILD (Ben's fold, 2026-11-11): the Stage 1 correction (epoch lifecycle honesty, detection tokens, reproducible bundle, reset preservation), Stage 2 substrate (F-6 completeness seals + register, per-attempt composer leases, no page-wide send-button fallback, final F-5 with LOGIC-FAULT, visible 45s defer vs 20s fence recheck, dispatch-side sealing with quarantine), Stage 3 (the background-owned held-message station: serial 7,500 ms append windows, append-pauses-timer + commit-and-send, push-through that bypasses nothing, cancel at the dispatch boundary, fail-closed focus-elected host with a control-less mirror, ATTEMPTING vs TRANSIT handshake faces) and Ben's visibility requirements (shared history parity in the popup, first-run honesty). v0.22.0 — CONCLUSION BUILD (Scope 03; joint plan with Claude, ruled in by Ben 2026-11-11, build tap 2026-11-12): a conclusion must not outlive its evidence — the receipt face now says only what is known ("clicked; receipt not yet observed", state keys unchanged); the detection handoff is acknowledged in four answer classes (accepted / duplicate-terminal / rejected / unanswered) with handed-off marking only after acceptance, bounded retries, drop reports on the same discipline, and the letterbox pending-cap eviction reported; pair close leaves a bounded retained handle per completed letter, which is the background-side duplicate authority after the forget, the tombstone that holds post-completion growth as a notice for Ben's carry-or-dismiss decision, and the retained text for a bounded late re-observation that can upgrade a verdict to DELIVERED-LATE and can never resend; a refused station action now writes a log line and surfaces on the overlay.
name: Pulse Bridge
